scenarios.name: base
scenarios.notes: Populate only from the actual account fee tier or a cited, predeclared scenario source.

observed_from_ingestion.dex_transaction_receipt_gas: optional; collect with --enrich-gas and an Ethereum mainnet RPC

rules: Never replace null values with unlabelled defaults.
Record provenance for every non-null execution assumption.
Treat publication-minus-execution time as exchange dissemination lag, not agent order latency.
Treat DEX swap slippage estimates as trade-size-specific diagnostics, not universal transaction costs.
